CFDocument.title: Florida K-12 Science Standards (2026 proposed rewrite, draft)
CFDocument.creator: Florida Department of Education (18-person development committee, 1 science-education professor)
CFDocument.description: Florida's first full K-12 science-standards rewrite since 2008, released for public comment 2026-09-25. Per multiple independently-fetched 2026 news sources, the draft's roughly 1,000 high-school benchmarks do not use the word 'evolution' in the life-science standards, and do not use 'climate change'/'global warming' anywhere in the document (retaining only 'weather and climate', 'climate systems', 'climate impacts on biodiversity'). Not built on the National Research Council's 2012 Framework for K-12 Science Education. Public comment via fldoe.org/standardsreview/; State Board vote expected December 2026.
